description.en: Jixi is a city in southeastern Heilongjiang Province, People's Republic of China. At the 2020 census, 1,502,060 people resided within its administrative area of 22,488.47 square kilometres and 560,118 in its built-up area made up of 3 out of 6 urban districts .
description.zh-CN: 鸡西市是中华人民共和国黑龙江省下辖的地级市，位于黑龙江省东南部。市境北与七台河市、双鸭山市相连，西与牡丹江市毗邻，东、南与俄罗斯滨海边疆区接壤。
description.zh-TW: 雞西市是中華人民共和國黑龍江省下轄的地級市，位於黑龍江省東南部。市境北與七臺河市、雙鴨山市相連，西與牡丹江市毗鄰，東、南與俄羅斯濱海邊疆區接壤。

photo.alt: Looking northeast along Xingguo Middle Road (兴国中路) from its intersection with Central Street (中小大街) at 11:20 local time in Jixi, China. About 500 metres from this point on the left, just beyond the green topped China Post building, is the train station. The bus station is a further 500 meters along, on the right just before the overpass apparent in the distance. Neither station is visible here as they are inset from the road. Screen capture from a Sanyo Xacti CS-1 video.
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

definition.en: A 24 km landscape window centred on Jixi.
definition.zh-CN: 以鸡西市的地理坐标为中心，展示周边约24公里宽的城区与地形。
definition.zh-TW: 以雞西市的地理座標爲中心，展示周邊約24公里寬的城區與地形。

description.en: A local landscape view from the urban area of Jixi, offering a closer look at its surroundings.
description.zh-CN: 这张实景照片呈现鸡西市城区周边的地方景观，为观察当地的街巷、建筑与自然环境提供一个现场视角。
description.zh-TW: 這張實景照片呈現雞西市城區周邊的地方景觀，爲觀察當地的街巷、建築與自然環境提供一個現場視角。
